items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Some people tell me at times that Schalke plays a lot, or one time played a lot like Kid Rene, too.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'm telling you, it really was an awful tragedy. And so anyway, he's getting along pretty good. He's getting along pretty good. And he said that the television show was the first wake he had since before Christmas. Well, I'm glad he was able to work with him. Yeah, he was able to work. And they had a tenor player with him, could play some tenor. And he wasn't on the show, but that's the group that he plays with. And this tenor player, he was terrific. Then I met Stan Getz. He lives in. Did he open there?…
Some people tell me at times that Schalke plays a lot, or one time played a lot like Kid Rene, too.

Well, yeah, I'll tell you one thing about it, if the people never pay much attention, Schalke is asking one of the original Dixon and trumpet men. I mean, he's one of them real, real, what you call Dixon and trumpet men. You know what I'm saying? You know what I'm saying? We got a lot of fellas that play a lot of horn and play it loud, but I mean when you come down to the street, talk about the original, that's it. Schalke is actually that kind of a trumpet player. You can't get that away from him, man. He's a…
